text:
sara: Proposal: add a "preview sandbox" flow for runtime config edits so owners can smoke-test without activating. Short sketch below.
liam: Strong +1. Main worry: preview divergence where preview behavior != prod. Need shadowing.
anjali: Shadow 0.5%-1% traffic to preview with header `x-config-preview: <id>`. No external side effects (webhooks stubbed).
mike: Implementation: preview state in Redis TTL + Postgres audit row. API: POST /v1/configs/{id}/previews => {preview_id, url}. Promote via POST /v1/configs/{id}/promote {preview_id,target_pct}.
sara: UX: show diff, "Start preview" button, cost estimate, and a small replay UI for sampled traces. Warn on cost.
liam: Telemetry: emit config.preview.created/applied/expired and config.divergence.score. Sample hashes, never raw payloads.
anjali: Divergence checker: run sampled inputs through prod+preview, compute semantic diff; if >threshold, mark preview unhealthy and block promote.
mike: Ops: add alert if preview causes >2 divergence alerts in 30m or latency > p99+10ms. Auto-rollback option.
sara: Auth: require config.preview scope; preview URLs signed and expire. Hosted: opt-in for customer shadowing.
liam: Rollout: internal org only behind feature-flag, then 5% customers. Prototype in staging this sprint.
anjali: I'll draft telemetry schema + sampling rules.
mike: I'll spin up proxy and stubbed webhook sink.
sara: I'll write RFC and mock console UI. Tagging folks for review @here.
deploybot: deploy-bot: preview-proxy pushed to staging 2024-06-11T09:14:02Z."
